correctness.rationale: The rank-one Laplacian edge deletion from K_{m,n}, with R0(a*,b*)=(m+n−1)/(mn)<1, gives pairwise corrected resistances R_ij=R0_ij+(v_i−v_j)^2/[mn(m−1)(n−1)] on four vertex classes. Euclidean embeddability of R as a distance, not √R, is decided by the centered Gram G=−1/2 J[R_ij²]J. The quadratic form on the zero-sum subspace splits into positive within-class contrasts and a three-dimensional four-group-mass block H. Direct rational formulas give H11>0, positive leading 2x2 minor except (2,2), and det H=−4AB/[m²n²(m−1)^4(n−1)^4], A=m²(m−n)+(n−2)(m+1), B=n²(m−n)−(m−2)(n+1). For m=n≥3, AB<0, hence H positive; for m≠n, AB>0 and H has exactly one negative direction. At m=n=2, K_2,2 minus an edge is P4 and effective resistance equals collinear path length: inertia (1,3,0). Strict 1-negative type is from the positive Laplacian pseudoinverse on zero-sum vectors; finite-metric openness yields >1, while the sign at 2 provides the phase division and P4 gives exactly 2. Independently inverted actual rational network Laplacians and checked centered Gram inertia for five size pairs including both boundary cases; all-order sign inequalities are the proof, not the finite experiments.

originality.rationale: The high-risk same-object primary antecedent Ge–Dong (2019) supplies exact effective resistances for K_mn minus arbitrary matching, explicitly including one deleted edge. Those resistance values are NOT claimed novel. The present evaluated classification concerns Schoenberg centered squares of those resistances and exact inertia: iff balanced Euclidean, with one negative mode otherwise, plus negative-type exponent phase separation. No theorem in Ge–Dong relevant Section5 computes or implies this evaluated sign class without new determinant work. Sánchez computes p-negative type for different (shortest-path) metrics, and Gervacio treats complete multipartite resistances without the deletion; Resultary query produced unrelated inertia claims. This is a best-of-knowledge mathematical distinction, not guaranteed nonexistence of an unindexed prior evaluation.

value.rationale: The canonical one-edge deletion asks whether a resistance metric that can have a Euclidean realization retains Hilbert embeddability under minimal graph perturbation. The clean all-order iff balance condition, exact number of negative squared-distance Gram directions and exceptional four-vertex path are substantive geometry of a natural graph family. Evaluating determinant signs is more than restating known resistance entries; negative-type exponent separation is a meaningful corollary. No exact formula for p_critical away from P4 is asserted.
